decision.next_machine_action: Keep polarity, horizon, costs and mapping unchanged. Reopen only after a PIT-safe executable transmission surface produces at least 5/5/5 standard-window treatment touches and freezes synchronous-leg, borrow, concentration, neutrality, overlap and replacement-value contracts; then run a new outcome-blind qualification.
decision.rationale: The mechanism remains researchable and its settled-forward counter is mature, but the candidate requested for qualify-to-Gates is not. The tilt has only 1/0/0 standard-window touches, the pair lacks a machine-verifiable executable transmission and complete two-leg envelope, and portfolio control blocks additions. Projecting an attribution-only lead would evade rather than satisfy those conditions.

researchability.basis: The observer has fixed known-at clocks, polarity, relation mapping and H10 settlement, with 655 negative-side closed rows across 72 events and 24 dates. The quantity bar now supports another frozen attribution question, but the deployable pair and core-entry tilt are not admission-ready: the tilt has only 1/0/0 standard-window touches, the pair lacks an executable substitute/neutrality mapping and complete two-leg execution contract, and current portfolio controls block new exposure.
limitations: The 655 rows are clustered within only 72 events and 24 event dates and are not 655 independent investment decisions.
Broad theme or SIC peer membership does not by itself prove a direct substitute, demand-transfer or beta-neutral pair relationship.
The observer begins in 2026, leaving the mid_weak and old_thin canonical windows structurally uncovered for an entry tilt.
A two-leg pair pays approximately 90bp under the frozen cost convention before borrow fee, recall, opening impact and capital carry.
The existing 40% attribution concentration screens are too loose to serve as live ticker, event, theme or sector caps.
Current account position control is false, all total-account shadow slots are consumed and forty bracket legs lack broker confirmation.
No current cohort return, PnL or excess_10d outcome was read before this card was frozen.

business_analyst.conclusion: PARK the current executable response. Intra-theme rotation or substitution after an adverse first-order event is economically coherent, but the machine mapping still proves only peer exposure, not a uniquely attributable tradeable substitute or neutral pair. A zero-capital attribution re-read would answer a narrower question than the requested shared-helper/Gate path and must not be used to bypass touch-density and transmission requirements.

evidence.claim: The registered lane has 655 negative-side closed rows across 72 events and 24 event dates, while the deployable tilt remains at 1/0/0 executable touches and the pair keeps fixed cost-aware bars.

The frozen prior candidate describes affected securities generically as second-order theme peers and explicitly allocates no instrument or capital, so it is an attribution contract rather than an executable decision mapping.

business_analyst.uncertainty: A narrower industry taxonomy or true customer/supplier/substitute graph could make the mechanism executable, but adopting one would be a new machine-verifiable gate shape that must be frozen and touch-counted outcome-blind.

financial_analyst.conclusion: The 655/650 maturity bar justifies at most one cost-aware observed-only attribution read. Deployment remains PARK: a pair must simultaneously exceed 100bp at event level and 45bp at row-mean level under the unchanged roughly 90bp two-leg cost, while today the honest incremental notional and concentration are both zero because cash/no-new-entry wins and account controls forbid additions.

evidence.claim: The broker snapshot reports portfolio value USD60767.98, cash USD11390.24 and twenty open positions; the total-account shadow has no free slot.
The canonical position-control snapshot has ok_to_add_control_pass false because forty bracket legs remain unconfirmed by the broker.
The frozen reopen note requires event-level separation above 100bp and row-level mean above 45bp before a pair sleeve may be built; costs, horizon and polarity may not be retuned.

financial_analyst.uncertainty: Borrow fees, locate failure, recall, opening impact, partial fills and overlap with the portfolio can consume the small residual even if a gross event-level spread narrowly clears 100bp.

industry_researcher.conclusion: PARK. The economic story is plausible, but the current response has no machine-verifiable industry transmission beyond broad peer membership and fails the explicit 5/5/5 treatment-touch rule at 1/0/0. A legal reopen needs a genuinely new, PIT-safe, executable transmission gate shape with at least five touches in every standard window; changing thresholds or relabelling the same peer set is not enough.

evidence.claim: The forward ledger identity is frozen and hashable, but the current registered deployable tilt intersects baseline entries only 1/0/0 times across late_strong, mid_weak and old_thin.

The current observer ledger has a deterministic event, polarity, first-order name, exposure ticker and relation identity surface, but those fields do not encode locate, beta neutrality, substitute strength or a live concentration-safe notional.

industry_researcher.uncertainty: The correct transmission may be customer, supplier, direct-product substitute or funding rotation rather than generic theme proximity; distinguishing them requires a new predeclared mapping, not an outcome-driven slice.

risk_assessor.conclusion: A frozen attribution-only viability read is legally reopenable on settled-forward growth, but the executable candidate is not. The row-growth axis does not waive 5/5/5 touches, source/component identity, transmission, concentration, borrow or shared-helper parity. Therefore PARK before candidate projection; any paper/live/canonical acceptance today would be a contract violation.

evidence.claim: The lane advanced from 433 to 655 negative-side closed rows, a gain of 222 and 51.3%, satisfying the registered settled-forward novelty axis without changing the policy.

Repository policy requires at least five treatment touches in each standard window for entry, downweight, single-name or narrow-population hypotheses and forbids using source-row density as a substitute.
Canonical shared default-off acceptance requires a shared decision helper, historical replay, daily default-off snapshot, parity and Gate 1-4 under trade_enabled=false.
